investigation_notes.Description: The alert identified unusually large (535 bytes) high-entropy DNS traffic to tiktokcdn.com originating from the workstation. The root domain tiktokcdn.com is long-established (created 2017) and the observed subdomain patterns (pull-rtmp, stream-hls, edge-live, pull-cmaf, res-static) match CDN/streaming resource naming; some hashed-looking labels were observed in recent host queries but are consistent with CDN object identifiers rather than clear encoded exfiltration. Recent host activity also includes legitimate developer/service queries (raw.githubusercontent.com, checkip.amazonaws.com) and there are no prior similar alerts, so the activity is assessed as Low Priority.
investigation_notes.Encoded/High-Entropy Subdomains Observed: Some hashed-looking subdomains seen in recent events, likely CDN resource identifiers; no decodable payload identified
investigation_notes.Recent Host Activity Summary: Host queried raw.githubusercontent.com and checkip.amazonaws.com and made multiple tiktokcdn.com queries with hashed resource labels; no recent similar alerts found
